title: Ice Cream Sandwich Cake Pops
description: Ice cream cake on a stick, crunchies and all! Transform ice cream sandwiches into cake pops with shell coating and your favorite assorted toppings.
ingredients: 2 (7.25 ounce) bottles chocolate shell topping (such as Magic Shell®)
assorted toppings such as sprinkles, crushed cookies, nuts, crushed candy bars

steps.text: Cut ice cream sandwiches in half crosswise. Insert a popsicle stick through up through the center of each cut end.
Remove the caps and seals from the shell topping. Place in the microwave and cook for 8 seconds. Pour each bottle shell topping into a glass measuring cup.
Dip each pop into shell topping until completely covered, allowing excess to drip off. Dip the top ends in desired toppings and place on parchment-lined baking sheet.
Freeze pops at least 1 hour before serving.

video.description: These three-ingredient summer treats will transform the way you enjoy an ice cream sandwich. In this video, Nicole shows you how to make ice cream sandwich pops with a chocolate magic shell coating! Made in less than ten minutes, these magical treats are guaranteed to be enjoyed by everyone at your next summer gathering.
